llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文主要研究支架材料，未涉及人工智能在生物打印中的应用。
llm.why_not_core: No AI integration, no bioprinting workflow automation, no experimental validation related to AI models.

summary_zh.motivation: 开发增强成骨活性的支架材料用于骨组织工程。
summary_zh.method: 制备β-磷酸三钙增强丝素蛋白复合支架。
summary_zh.result: 复合支架显著促进成骨分化。
summary_zh.validation: 通过体外细胞实验验证成骨效果。

summary_en.motivation: To develop a scaffold material with enhanced osteogenic activity for bone tissue engineering.
summary_en.method: Fabricated β-tricalcium phosphate reinforced silk fibroin composite scaffolds.
summary_en.result: The composite scaffolds significantly promoted osteogenic differentiation.
summary_en.validation: In vitro cell culture experiments were performed to validate osteogenic efficacy.
